profile.summary: Secondary school science teacher who designs lesson plans and digital quizzes.

bullets: Taught physics and chemistry to 4 sections of Grade 9 and 10, about 160 students.
Designed 30 Google Classroom quizzes and lesson plans aligned to the CBSE syllabus.
Raised the Grade 10 science pass rate from 82% to 94% over 2 years.

jd.title: Instructional Designer
jd.text: Design e-learning courses using ADDIE, storyboard modules, build content in Articulate Storyline, write assessments and work with subject matter experts. 2+ years in instructional design; a teaching background is welcome.

output.summary: Science Teacher with 6+ years of professional experience designing lesson plans and digital quizzes, seeking the Instructional Designer role. Experienced instructional designer skilled in ADDIE and storyboarding.

profile_improvement_tips: Complete a short course in Articulate Storyline and build one sample e-learning module.
